evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence

evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Capacity schedule is not proof of standards-compliant usable capacity.

evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence

evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence

evidence.limits: No verified subsequent TB correction in reviewed record.

evidence.claim: ICE medical oversight found absent comprehensive assessments and no diabetes/HIV treatment plans.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Oversight findings reported by GAO, not independently reread underlying ICE report.

evidence.claim: Weapons discrepancy report followed loaded firearm loss; still unrecovered as of March according to ICE official.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: March observation is not October current status.

evidence.claim: ODO inspection found49 deficiencies including3 priority issues and rated facility acceptable.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Tool control, ammunition controls, and TB-symptom notification were priority issues. Rating is not proof of all deficiencies corrected.

evidence.claim: ICE reports covered absent dietician menu-review evidence, six transportation failures, and missing use-of-force/death reports for January death; autopsy classified homicide due to asphyxia; associated evidence missing or destroyed.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Medical classification is not a criminal conviction; OPR inquiry paused pending criminal investigation as of April2026.

evidence.claim: About1,600 detainees; five1,000-person units operating; meals paid for5,000. ICE cited segregation/isolation needs; GAO noted subdivisions within units.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Observed population, physical/contract capacity, safely usable capacity and paid quantity are separate.

evidence.claim: Reports covered sanitation, October escape and January suicide: observation intervals exceeded15min and vision panels requested in October were not installed by the death.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Contractor reported ongoing/planned fixes; some reports draft/pending as of March; no item-level closure proof.

evidence.claim: ICE awarded noncompetitive undefinitized replacement contract to different vendor for operation beginning April18 through September30.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Award verified through GAO; operating success not established.

evidence.claim: Initial contract terminated for convenience; GAO could not yet assess replacement effectiveness or inclusion of quality-assurance surveillance plan.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Termination for convenience is not a default finding or demonstrated cure.

evidence.claim: Defense response agreed to lessons assessment while disputing GAO conclusions and alleged overreliance on ICE.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Underlying January documentation and April10 rebuttal not independently read. GAO defended balanced attribution on p22.

evidence.claim: DHS response planned tiered pricing, reduction from5,000 to4,000 beds with initial1,500 funding and250-bed increments; asserted existing inspection controls and requested recommendation closure.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Plans not verified implementation. Pricing target December31; DHS lessons date TBD. GAO rejected inspection-policy sufficiency.

evidence.claim: GAO published four recommendations: pricing, pre-occupancy controls, Army lessons and DHS lessons.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical event, not new occurrence

evidence.claim: As of August, replacement contract still lacked occupancy-sensitive cost-saving measures and ICE paid for unneeded services; contract prices remained under negotiation. Assistance agreement still active.
evidence.discovery: case detail from retained source; historical observation, not new occurrence
evidence.limits: Actual dated pricing nonimplementation, not proof of no safety fixes or of current October pricing. June findings recited in this follow-up are derivative, not independent corroboration.
